title: About Me
intro: I'm Daniel. I enjoy building software and understanding how all the pieces fit together, from the interface to the backend and the infrastructure running it. My projects often start with something I want to use myself, like Nootflix, a media system I build and run across my home server and the cloud. I've also worked as a functional analyst intern at Desjardins.
body: Outside of software, I spend my time trail running, training for endurance events, tinkering with hardware, and reading science fiction. I like figuring out how things work, trying ideas, and having something tangible to show for the effort.
